title: 'Higurashi no Naku Koro ni' New Anime Announced
content: Production company Kadokawa announced a new television anime for the Higurashi no Naku Koro ni ( Higurashi: When They Cry ) visual novel franchise on Sunday, revealing a teaser visual (pictured) and an announcement video.
author: MyAnimeList

title: MAPPA’s 3 Newly Revealed Anime, Ranked
content: MAPPA held its fifteenth anniversary event on June 19, 2026, using the occasion to celebrate with the exciting announcement of new seasons and fresh reveals. Fans were naturally curious about major titles such as Jujutsu Kaisen and Chainsaw Man , and while they got what they wanted, the studio also unveiled several…

title: Higurashi When They Cry New TV Anime by Studio DEEN Announced
content: Higurashi When They Cry new TV anime is officially in production, with studio DEEN in charge of the animation. The reveal came with a teaser PV, featuring the message “Everyone, welcome back,” before confirming that a new TV anime project based on Ryukishi07’s horror franchise is now in production.
author: Anime Corner

title: After Nearly Seven Years, Crunchyroll’s Most Unique Sci-Fi Anime Unveils Its Main Villain, and It’s AI
content: After nearly seven years of releasing new seasons since 2019, Crunchyroll ‘s most unique sci-fi anime is ending, and ahead of the finale, it reveals its main villain, which is surprisingly AI.
author: ComicBook

title: New Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha Anime's Latest Video Reveals New Cast Member
content: The staff for Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha EXCEEDS Gun Blaze Vengeance , the Magical Girl Lyrical Nanoha franchise 's 20th anniversary anime , revealed the anime's second promotional video, a new version of the main visual, and a new cast member on Sunday.
author: ANN

title: BanG Dream! YUME∞MITA Anime Reveals New Trailer, 3 Episode-Premiere Confirmed
content: Bang Dream: Yumemita (stylized BanG Dream! YUME∞MITA) revealed a new trailer, along with confirming a 3-episode premiere for July 2. NICHICALINE is in charge of the animation production. Tomomi Umezu is the director for the anime, with Hiroshi Morita as assistant director.
author: Anime Corner

title: Fatal Fury City of the Wolves Game Reveals Trailer for Crossover DLC Character Kenshiro
content: SNK revealed a DLC character trailer on Friday for the Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves fighting game featuring Kenshiro from Fist of the North Star . The character will debut in the game as part of the Season Pass 2 in June.
author: ANN

title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War - The Calamity Anime Reveals Song Artists, July 25 Debut
content: The staff for Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War - The Calamity , the fourth and final part of the Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War anime, unveiled on Sunday the anime's main visual, theme song artists, and July 25 premiere.
author: ANN

title: Shinobi: Art of Vengeance Game Launches on Switch 2 on September 24
content: Sega announced in a trailer on Friday that it will launch Shinobi: Art of Vengeance , the new game in its Shinobi franchise , on Nintendo Switch 2 on September 24. A Deluxe Edition of the game for Switch 2 will include the Sega Villains Stage DLC.
author: ANN
